snippet.title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes will be landing on Steam in early 2026: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535950/Battlestar_Galactica_Scattered_Hopes/

In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, you command a fleet of spaceships fleeing humanity’s settled worlds, known as the Twelve Colonies, when Cylons–a sentient robotic species created by humans to make their life easier–suddenly turn against their creators.

In this story-rich tactical roguelite, take command of one of the many fleets escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies:
- Manage onboard crises as you prepare for the relentless encounters with the Cylon Fleet.
- Lead your fighters through high-risk battles.
- Jump to new sectors before the Cylons turn your ships into astral debris.

With humanity’s haven in the Twelve Colonies now uninhabitable, your tactical leadership is your crew’s only hope of surviving the journey to humankind’s last hope, the Battlestar Galactica.

Stay updated and join the Fleet’s HQ on social media:
💫 X - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes : https://x.com/playbsg
💫 Facebook - Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes : https://www.facebook.com/playbsg
💫 Discord - Alt Shift : https://discordapp.com/invite/jgdQ7XY
